channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: An unaffordable car market highlights Iran’s cost-of-living crisis
item.description: Some officials and state media have long openly described the industry as a ‘mafia’ system.

item.title: Taiwan flexes military capabilities ahead of Trump-Xi talks
item.description: Taiwan has staged live-fire drills with missiles and attack drones as Donald Trump prepares to host China’s Xi Jinping.

item.title: Child among three Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza
item.description: Gaza’s Health Ministry says the son of its director general, Munir al-Bursh, is among those killed.

item.title: Iran stages show of force during mobilisation campaign in Tehran
item.description: Armed women, anti-aircraft guns and Shaheed drones were seen in Tehran as hundreds of thousands marched in the capital.

item.title: Russia kills eight people in Ukraine, attacks two vessels in Black Sea
item.description: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia hit the country with dozens of drones and two antiship missiles overnight.

item.title: Nigerian forces fire at protesters rallying over deaths of detained miners
item.description: Nigerian security forces have opened fire on protesters angry over the deaths of 37 miners who died in detention.

item.title: Turkiye revokes operating licence of Iran’s Bank Mellat in Istanbul
item.description: The Iranian lender has faced years of Western sanctions over alleged ties to Tehran's nuclear programme.

item.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
item.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

item.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
item.description: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

item.title: Saudi Arabia issues first air raid alerts for Riyadh since Houthis escalated attacks
item.description: Residents later received the all-clear after explosions were reported in the capital.
